image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a handmade or craft-style bib lying on a blue textured fabric background. The bib has a translucent or semi-transparent plastic/vinyl outer layer with an orange stitched border. Inside the transparent pocket, there is a chaotic arrangement of colorful objects including pink yarn balls, green rectangular blocks, white folded fabric, and other small trinkets. A strap made of multi-colored webbing loops out from the top.
